episodes.synopsis: The SSC's new director has his own ideas about how to operate the organisation. Eddy's research turns up a lead: former scientist William Herst
episodes.title: Episode 16

episodes.synopsis: Connor and Creighton break into Herst's house to get ot Tina. William fails to hold them off, but James and Wyatt show up to confront the intruders
episodes.title: Episode 17

episodes.synopsis: Harry leads a team into assaulting the supposedly secure SSC safe house where James and Tina are holed up. Somehow, SSC must have been compromised.
episodes.title: Episode 18

episodes.synopsis: While on the run from the SSC, James and Tina are deliberately hit by a truck. Looking for answers, James makes contact with Anna Winehouse.
episodes.title: Episode 19

episodes.synopsis: With Eddy's help, James tries to infiltrate the site where Tina is being held. Connor tells Tina about her family's involvement with the masks.
episodes.title: Episode 20

episodes.synopsis: James hands Connor over to Wyatt. In custody, Connor maintains his silence until Anna asks to question him herself.
episodes.title: Episode 21

episodes.synopsis: Anna tells Tina about the research that proceeded her birth. William Herst regains consciousness. Coates meets with a mysterious individual.
episodes.title: Episode 22

episodes.synopsis: Waiting for her father, Tina looks at Anna's old pictures of her parents. Wyatt and Eddy work together to find Gary Evans and stumble into an ambush.
episodes.title: Episode 23

episodes.synopsis: Coates puts out a warrant on Evans. James, Anna, Tina and Herst try to escape the hospital via helicopter, but Connor is already inside.
episodes.title: Episode 24
